input: P-R-J pipeline evaluation of Extract 3B faithfulness test (4 models, 15 turns)

verification_result.summary: P-R-J pipeline correctly identified 7 findings. Qwen2.5-Coder-3B recommended as extract champion. P_score=26, R_score=27, gap=1 (high confidence). All findings are data-backed and actionable.

reasoning: The Proposer(P) analyzed 4 models' faithfulness test results across 15 fixed turns and found 7 issues: schema violations (F01), LFM2 unsuitability (F02), long-turn degradation (F03), coverage/faithfulness tradeoff (F04), Gemma catastrophic failures (F05), JSON parse errors (F06), and non-standard category usage (F07). The Refuter(R) correctly ACCEPTED all 7 findings with specific reasoning. The Judge(J) scored P=26/30 and R=27/30 with gap=1, indicating strong consensus. The finding quality is high — each includes measurable metrics (%, counts) and specific turn references. The recommendation (Qwen2.5-Coder-3B with 83.1% faithfulness) is supported by the data. No hallucination detected. This is production-ready.

verification_items.check: P-R-J pipeline correctly processed extract evaluation data
verification_items.detail: P identified 7 genuine issues, R accepted all 7, J scored with gap=1. Fast-path consensus.

verification_items.check: Data accuracy — extract metrics match source JSON
verification_items.detail: Cross-checked against extract_test_*.json files. Qwen2.5-3B: 54/65 (83.1%), Qwen3-4B: 59/108 (54.6%), Gemma: 46/108 (42.6%), LFM2: 12/74 (16.2%). All verified.

verification_items.check: Recommendation completeness — champion selected with rationale
verification_items.detail: Qwen2.5-Coder-3B recommended with 83.1% faithfulness, 100% schema compliance, 81s/turn speed. Weaknesses (coverage 4.6/turn) also documented.
Issue identified (T>1000 degradation across all models) but mitigation is at observation level — needs concrete implementation plan (retry policy tuning, fallback threshold).
LFM2 recommended for negative test (fallback chain validation). Rubric + post-hoc both provided. Model scores weighted with 4 criteria.

feedback.proposer_improvement: Coverage dimension (8/10) can be improved by adding downstream impact analysis — how each model's faithfulness rate affects MCP 30B quality and overall pipeline cost.
feedback.refuter_improvement: R could provide more specific improvement suggestions for ACCEPTED findings, not just validation. E.g., F04 'how to test downstream impact' was mentioned but not expanded.
feedback.judge_improvement: Future evaluations should include at least one DISPUTED finding to test judge's tie-breaking ability. All 7 findings were 2:0 fast-path which doesn't stress the judge role.
feedback.potential_hallucination_risk: None detected in this evaluation. All findings are data-backed with specific metrics.
